comment: The Bleakhold café: The Lion's Roast (Stormwind) and The Grinding Tusk (Orgrimmar). The only source of the café content: python3 -I Tools/CafeForge/cafeforge_data.py writes Server/mod-bleakhold-ui/src/BleakholdCafeData.h, Interface/AddOns/Bleakhold/CafeData.lua and Server/mod-bleakhold-ui/data/sql/db-world/04_bleakhold_cafe_templates.sql from it. Ids are append-only: never renumber or reuse one. Text is original enUS.

cafes.name: The Lion's Roast
cafes.tagline: Coffee · Tea · Shakes, by the Cathedral steps

serverFirst.text: First Master Barista of The Lion's Roast
First Master Barista of The Grinding Tusk

1: Cathedral Black
Dark as the crypts beneath the Cathedral and twice as bracing.
2: Grunt's Black
Strong enough to stand a spear in. Grunts swear by it; peons swear at it.

1: Elwynn Morning Latte
Steamed milk over a single shot, the way Elwynn wakes: slowly, then all at once.
2: Durotar Dust Latte
The colour of Durotar at dawn. The dust is optional.

1: Goldshire Honey Cappuccino
Foam as soft as a Goldshire haystack, sweetened with Elwynn honey.
2: Bloodhoof Honey Cappuccino
Foam sweetened with Mulgore honey. The tauren insist on sharing.

1: Lionheart Double
Two shots and a dusting of cinnamon. Courage, in a cup.
2: Lok'tar Double
Two shots and cinnamon. Victory or exhaustion, whichever comes first.

1: Westfall Harvest Mocha
Chocolate, cream and coffee for the long harvest days on the Westfall farms.
2: Crossroads Caravan Mocha
The drink of every caravan that survived the Barrens road.

1: Stormwind Harbor Iced Latte
Poured over ice for sailors who've had quite enough of warm, thank you.
2: Steamwheedle Iced Latte
Iced and vanilla'd by goblin standards. Comes with a receipt.

1: The King's Reserve
Two shots, caramel and a crown of cream. Rumour says it was poured the day King Varian came home.
2: Warchief's Reserve
Two shots, caramel and cream. Grukka swears she'll serve the Warchief one herself someday.

1: Elwynn Green
Light leaves, a spoon of honey, and the smell of the forest after rain.
2: Valley of Wisdom Green
Brewed calm enough for a shaman's morning.

1: Abbey Black
Steeped strong the Northshire way, softened with cream for long hours of prayer.
2: Mulgore Plains Black
Steeped long as the evening shadows on the plains, with kodo cream.

1: Redridge Spiced Chai
Simmered with spices the traders swear they bought legally in Lakeshire.
2: Darkspear Spice Brew
Spices crushed by hand and simmered the Echo Isles way.

1: Dun Morogh Mint Frost
Mint tea over ice. Tastes like a snowball, minus the dwarf who threw it.
2: Sen'jin Mint Cooler
Mint tea over ice for the hottest afternoons in Durotar.

1: Duskwood Night Blend
Strong black tea, cinnamon and foam. Best sipped with every lantern lit.
2: Deathguard Bitter Root
Brewed strong enough that even the Forsaken notice.

1: Silver Covenant Starleaf
Light leaf, berry and honey under steamed milk. Approved by at least one magister.
2: Eversong Sunleaf
Light leaf, cactus apple and honey under steamed milk. A taste of Quel'Thalas in the desert.

1: Vanilla Lion Cub
One scoop, real vanilla, no fuss. The orphanage's favourite.
2: Peon's Vanilla Payday
A peon's reward for a week of hauling.

1: Goldshire Berry Swirl
Ice cream, cold milk and Elwynn berries, blended pink.
2: Cactus Apple Smash
Blended until it stops being prickly.

1: Ironforge Rocky Road
Two scoops and chocolate, piled like the Khaz Modan peaks.
2: Razor Hill Rocky Road
As rough and sweet as Razor Hill itself.

1: Gnomeregan Fizz-Shake
Minted, blended and iced. The fizz is a feeling, not an ingredient.
2: Gearbox Fizz-Shake
Blended in Nixxi's Shake-Shredder. Do not ask about the noise.

1: Darnassian Moonlight Dream
Honey, cream and two scoops, smooth as Teldrassil moonlight.
2: Kodo Stampede
Two scoops, honey and kodo cream, big enough to need two hands.

1: Champion's Triple Scoop
Training food for the Argent Tournament, allegedly.
2: Valley of Honor Triple Scoop
Earned in the Ring, eaten in triumph.

levels.text: Black coffee, latte, green tea and black tea. One ticket at a time; the first drink is forgiving.
Honey cappuccino, vanilla shake and berry shake.
Mocha and rocky road. Two tickets at once.
Iced latte and mint tea. Apprentice's Apron.
Night tea and fizz-shake. From memory mode: hide the checklist.
Honey cream shake. Staff Drink: a free buff after a shift of 10 drinks, once a day.
Leaf tea under steamed milk. Three tickets at once.
The Reserve. Regulars tip you more.
Triple scoop. The title "the Barista" and the Master Barista's Apron.

lines.shiftOffered: Fancy an apron? The counter's yours if your hands are steady.
lines.shiftStart: Apron on, sleeves up. Take the next order at the counter.
lines.shiftEnd: Good work. Your tips are in your purse and the grinder's still in one piece.
lines.rushStart: The bells are ringing eight! Here comes the Morning Rush, everyone to the bar!
lines.houseOrder: No barista on shift? Then I'll make it myself. Give me a minute, dear.
lines.takeover: Let me finish that one, dear. Take a breath.
lines.dangerPause: Everyone stay calm and keep your cups level!
idle: If the King himself walks in, nobody faint.
Tobias, those beans won't grind themselves.
lines.refuse: We don't serve your kind here.

lines.tutorialShot: Pull the shot when the bar hits gold. Too early, it's water; too late, it's tar.
lines.tutorialSteam: Milk wants to sing, not scream. Stop the steam at the gold.
lines.levelUp: Level {n} already? You'll be pulling for nobles soon.
lines.houseOrder: Rosalind's busy, so you've got me. One moment.

idle: Cups! Anyone finished with their cup?
Miss Rosalind says no running by the kettle. I'm walking. Fast.
lines.rush: Rush! Rush! Mind your elbows, cups coming through!

staff.name: Agnes Pemberton
staff.comment: display 13 from Peasant Woman (65); ambient, no vendor in v1

idle: Fresh cinnamon from the market, dear. Don't ask what it cost.

lines.shiftOffered: Strong arms and steady hands? Then the counter's yours for a while.
lines.shiftStart: Grab an apron. Take orders at the counter. Burn nothing.
lines.shiftEnd: You worked, you get paid. Lok'tar.
lines.rushStart: The sun's up and so is every grunt in the Valley of Strength. RUSH!
lines.houseOrder: No barista? Fine. I'll make it myself, and I'll be grumpy about it.
lines.takeover: Too slow. Move, I'll finish it.
lines.dangerPause: Enemies in the Valley! Hold your cups and stay behind the counter!
idle: I kept Warsong Hold awake through its first winter. Orgrimmar will be easy.
Gorrak, wipe that counter before a grunt sticks to it.
lines.refuse: We don't serve your kind here.

lines.tutorialShot: Shot first, milk second. Like a charge: sword first, shouting second.
lines.tutorialSteam: Steam until the milk stops arguing. Stop at the gold.
lines.levelUp: Level {n}. The grunts will start saluting your cups.
lines.houseOrder: Grukka's busy. I'll brew it. Stand back.

staff.name: Nixxi Sparkvalve
staff.comment: built the Tusk-o-Matic; display 29904 from Goblin Mechanic (35346)

idle: The Tusk-o-Matic runs at nine atmospheres. Don't ask about ten.
A tiny bit of every tip belongs to my patent. Kidding! Mostly.
lines.rush: Pressure's climbing! Keep those shots moving or she'll blow!

idle: Tea be patient, mon. You be patient too.
Green leaf steeps short, black leaf steeps long. Listen to da kettle.
I'm the fastest cup carrier in the whole Valley!
lines.rush: Out of the way, out of the way! Hot cups for the Horde!

staff.name: Tahna Sweetgrass
staff.comment: tauren milk supplier by the cold box; display 19183 from Tauren Commoner (19176)

idle: Fresh kodo milk, morning-cold. The Earth Mother provides; the kodo complains.

personas.name: Sergeant Corwin Ashgrove
personas.order: Cathedral Black. No sugar, no chatter, no delay.
personas.thanks: Hot and bitter. Like my shift.
personas.complaint: I've stood shorter watches on the wall. I'm off.

personas.name: Private Tilly Dunmore
personas.order: Er... the vanilla one? Don't tell the sergeant.
personas.thanks: Lovely! Back to the gate!
personas.complaint: I'll be late for drill!
personas.comment: looks from Stormwind Guard (1423); her own line names the vanilla shake, so M1 is her first favourite

personas.name: Magister Ellandra Silvershade
personas.order: The Starleaf, if your hands are equal to it. I can taste carelessness.
personas.thanks: Acceptable. In fact... rather good.
personas.complaint: In Dalaran they would have teleported it to me by now.
personas.comment: looks from Silver Covenant Guardian Mage (29254)

personas.name: Brother Odric
personas.order: An Abbey Black, child, with a little cream. The Light is patient; so am I.
personas.thanks: Bless you, and bless this kettle.
personas.complaint: Patience is a virtue... which I appear to have used up.

personas.name: Lady Seraphine Ravenmoor
personas.order: The King's Reserve. And do wipe the cup first.
personas.thanks: Hm. I may return. Tell no one.
personas.complaint: I was told this establishment had standards.

personas.name: Lord Percival Ashcombe
personas.order: A Westfall Mocha. My steward insists the farms are thriving; let us taste the evidence.
personas.thanks: Splendid. Something extra in the jar for the young barista.
personas.complaint: I have sat through shorter sessions of the House of Nobles.
personas.comment: look from Lord Baurles K. Wishock (1439)

personas.name: Grandma Hester
personas.order: A nice green tea, dearie. Take your time; I've nowhere to be.
personas.thanks: Just like I made before my hands got stiff.
personas.complaint: Well. I'll go home and boil my own.

personas.name: Little Wendel
personas.order: One Lion Cub, please! With extra lion!
personas.thanks: It's so cold my teeth hurt! Best day ever!
personas.complaint: Matron says I can't wait forever. Bye!

personas.name: Tessa Furrow
personas.order: A Westfall Harvest Mocha. It tastes like home, they say.
personas.thanks: Like home, only less dusty.
personas.complaint: I've a cart to watch. Never mind.

personas.name: Keldrin Coalbrand
personas.order: Rocky Road, lad, piled high as the Dun Morogh peaks!
personas.thanks: Proper drink! Almost as good as ale.
personas.complaint: Bah! Faster service at a Dark Iron tavern.

personas.name: Fizzbee Gearlight
personas.order: Fizz-Shake, extra fizz! Science demands it.
personas.thanks: The bubbles are on the correct axis!
personas.complaint: My experiment is about to explode. Literally. Bye!

personas.name: Sentinel Ilyara
personas.order: The Moonlight Dream. I am told it tastes of Teldrassil.
personas.thanks: Elune smile on your kettle.
personas.complaint: The forest is more patient than I am, it seems.

personas.name: Vindicator Teluun
personas.order: The Night Blend. The Naaru keep no hours, and neither do I.
personas.thanks: The Light flows even through this. Remarkable.
personas.complaint: My post awaits. Another day, perhaps.

personas.name: Harbormaster Wilma Keel
personas.order: Harbor Iced Latte. Cold, like the wind off the docks.
personas.thanks: That'll keep me sharp till the next ship.
personas.complaint: The tide waits for no one, and neither do I.

personas.name: Aldous Penn
personas.order: Black. And you didn't see me.
personas.thanks: Good. Forget my face.
personas.complaint: emote:leaves a coin on the counter and is gone.

personas.name: Marla Hobbs
personas.order: Redridge Chai, please. My ovens have been going since four.
personas.thanks: Spiced just right. I'll send you a loaf.
personas.complaint: My bread is burning! Some other day!

personas.name: Edric Cole
personas.order: Lionheart Double. Exams. Don't ask.
personas.thanks: I can see through time now. Thank you.
personas.complaint: I'll fall asleep in the library instead.

personas.name: Thorne the Fisher
personas.order: Black tea with cream. Fish don't bite till I've had one.
personas.thanks: Ahh. Now I can sit still for six hours.
personas.complaint: Fish are biting and you're not brewing.

personas.name: Ilsabet Vane
personas.order: The Night Blend. Tastes like Duskwood without the wolves.
personas.thanks: Dark and gentle, like a night with the lanterns lit.
personas.complaint: I've waited less in the Raven Hill crypts.

personas.name: Squire Benedict Arland
personas.order: The Champion's Triple Scoop! Champions need... calcium.
personas.thanks: This is what victory tastes like!
personas.complaint: A true champion knows when to retreat. That's now.

personas.name: Hollis Bran
personas.order: A latte, and a Berry Swirl for the lad minding my cart.
personas.thanks: Back to the barrels, then.
personas.complaint: Barrels won't count themselves.

personas.name: Night Watch Guard
personas.order: Three for the Night Watch! Two black, one milky; he's new.
personas.thanks: The Watch thanks you. Mostly for the black ones.
personas.complaint: We'll sleep without it. Grumpily.
personas.comment: Rush group: three guards in consecutive queue slots; the first says the order line, the others use pool A

personas.name: Stormwind Citizen
personas.comment: a random display of the list and a random recipe; lines from pool A

personas.name: Cathedral Chorister
personas.order: Three teas for the Cathedral Choir, please. We sing at nine.
personas.thanks: Bless you. We'll sing a verse for your kettle.
personas.complaint: We'll sing hoarse, then. The Light forgives you.
personas.comment: Rush group (the Cathedral Choir); its own template so the choir does not carry the Stormwind Citizen name, and three members as every Rush group

personas.name: Grunt Gashrok
personas.order: Grunt's Black. Hot. Now.
personas.thanks: Strong! Strength and honor.
personas.complaint: Shorter waits in a siege line!

personas.name: Kor'kron Morka
personas.order: Lok'tar Double. The Warchief rises early; so do his guards.
personas.thanks: Swift and strong. You'd make a decent Kor'kron.
personas.complaint: Duty calls. Your kettle doesn't.

personas.name: Peon Drekk
personas.order: Me finish hauling. Me want sweet cold thing!
personas.thanks: Ooooh. Cold in head. Good cold.
personas.complaint: Overseer calling. Me go back. Sad.

personas.name: Zuja
personas.order: Darkspear Spice Brew, mon, de Echo Isles way.
personas.thanks: Da spirits be smilin' on dis cup.
personas.complaint: Da loa be impatient today. Me too.

personas.name: Ruuk Plainsrunner
personas.order: Mulgore Plains Black, with kodo cream. Steep it long.
personas.thanks: The Earth Mother would approve.
personas.complaint: The plains call me home. Another sunrise.

personas.name: Deathguard Morven
personas.order: Bitter Root. I cannot taste it; I come for the steam.
personas.thanks: Warm. I had forgotten warm.
personas.complaint: I waited six years in a crypt. Not for tea.

personas.name: Apothecary Lisette
personas.order: Bitter Root, strong. I'm studying its effects on the living.
personas.thanks: Fascinating. Your heart rate will tell me more. Kidding.
personas.complaint: I'll brew something in my lab. Something worse.

personas.name: Magister Lorethien Sunweaver
personas.order: Eversong Sunleaf. Lightly steeped. Precisely.
personas.thanks: Nearly as good as Silvermoon. Nearly.
personas.complaint: In Silvermoon we'd have it by now.

personas.name: Tinkzip
personas.order: What's a Gearbox Fizz cost? Never mind, I'll pay. I'm writing it down.
personas.thanks: Time is money, and you saved me both.
personas.complaint: Waiting costs money, friend. I'm out.

personas.name: Grizzlik
personas.order: Lok'tar Double, and if the Tusk-o-Matic smokes, it wasn't me.
personas.thanks: Now THAT's a pressure reading.
personas.complaint: Zeppelin's leaving! Go-go-go!

personas.name: Ghazz Wolfrider
personas.order: Caravan Mocha. Three days of Barrens dust need washing out.
personas.thanks: That's the Barrens out of my throat.
personas.complaint: My wolf is chewing your sign. We're leaving.

personas.name: Little Grak
personas.order: Cactus Apple Smash! I can pay in shiny rocks!
personas.thanks: So cold my future tusks hurt!
personas.complaint: Matron Battlewail's calling! Bye!

personas.name: Shaman Garnak
personas.order: Valley Green. Water and earth should both be in it.
personas.thanks: Balanced. The elements thank you.
personas.complaint: The spirits are restless, and so am I.

personas.name: Jinzo
personas.order: Sen'jin Mint Cooler, mon. Da sun be cookin' me head.
personas.thanks: Cool like de sea at Sen'jin.
personas.complaint: Too hot to wait, mon.

personas.name: Zalza
personas.order: Da Spice Brew. Da loa like it strong, and so does Zalza.
personas.thanks: Da spirits dance in dis one.
personas.complaint: Da bones say leave. Zalza listen to da bones.

personas.name: Hagra
personas.order: Rocky Road. Big. I won today.
personas.thanks: Sweet as victory!
personas.complaint: I don't wait. I win. Bye.

personas.name: Elder Tahoma
personas.order: Something warm for old hooves, young one.
personas.thanks: You have a gentle hand with the kettle.
personas.complaint: The wind says it is time to go.

personas.name: Maz'reth the Wanderer
personas.order: Your Warchief's Reserve. On Argus we had nothing worth remembering.
personas.thanks: Exquisite. The Horde surprises me daily.
personas.complaint: Patience is a mortal virtue. I am leaving.
personas.comment: a Bleakhold-only persona: disabled until the owner confirms the lore and a realm Eredar display; templateDisplay only fills the creature_template_model row while the display is 0

personas.name: Old Ughra Scarjaw
personas.order: Warchief's Reserve. I've earned it.
personas.thanks: A brew worth a war story.
personas.complaint: I've survived worse than slow service. Barely.

personas.name: Skyrunner Tavo
personas.order: Iced latte, fast. My wind rider hates waiting more than I do.
personas.thanks: Cold as the clouds over the Barrens.
personas.complaint: My wind rider's biting the tower. Gotta go.

personas.name: Kodo Dairy Hand
personas.order: A Kodo Stampede, two straws. We earned it.
personas.thanks: Now that's kodo cream used right.
personas.complaint: The herd won't milk itself.

personas.name: Warsong Recruit
personas.order: Three for the Warsong! We ship out at noon!
personas.thanks: For the Horde, and for the coffee!
personas.complaint: We'll fight Scourge half-asleep then!
personas.comment: Rush group: three recruits; the first says the order line, the others use pool H

personas.name: Orgrimmar Citizen
personas.comment: a random display of the list and a random recipe; lines from pool H

personas.name: Kor'kron Guard
personas.order: Shift's over. Three Lok'tar Doubles, and fast.
personas.thanks: The Warchief's guard owes you one. Briefly.
personas.complaint: The next shift can bring its own.
personas.comment: Rush group (the Kor'kron shift change), with Kor'kron Morka's looks; its own template so the guards do not carry her name

npcText.text: Welcome to the Lion's Roast. Mind the steps, love: the Cathedral bells shake the cups loose.
In or out, but don't block the door. The Grinding Tusk serves the Horde, one cup at a time.

Work a shift behind the counter: take an order, then walk to each station the ticket names and press its key. A timed step wants a second press while the bar is in the gold. Serve at the counter before the customer runs out of patience. Customers order from me, and a barista on shift makes the drink, or I do.

Take an order at the counter. Walk to every station on the ticket and press its key. Timed steps: press again in the gold, not before, not after. Serve before the customer gives up. No barista on shift? Then I make it.
Coffee, tea and shakes, made fresh at the counter. You pay when you order; a barista on shift makes your drink, or I will, and it is yours when it is ready.
Pick a drink. Pay first. A barista makes it, or I do. It is ready when it is ready.
The best baristas of the week, by café points. The top ten are paid at the weekly reset, and the winner is Best Barista for a week.
The strongest arms behind my counter this week, by café points. The top ten get paid at the weekly reset. The best one gets bragging rights for a week.
We don't serve your kind here.
